tier_rationale: state_agency, 2 complexity signals, cost weight None. State agency, statewide reach, and multicultural/bilingual messaging across multiple priority populations justify High-tier pricing depth and staffing.

Rural peer state (CO, OR, SD, WY) strategy research report
Direct Outreach campaign strategy for Priority Populations
Copy and recommendations for 988 webpage redesign
Project management and printing/fulfillment vendor coordination across the five-year term

Public awareness support, meeting support, focus groups, and priority population engagement
Tactical strategy, ad hoc input, and statewide MT988 distribution strategy

sections.heading: 1. Compensation Contingent on Approved Deliverables
sections.body_md: Payment is tied to completed tasks and deliverables the Department has reviewed and approved. Nothing is invoiced for work that has not been accepted.

sections.heading: 2. Deliverable Invoice Approval
sections.body_md: Every invoice ties to a specific approved deliverable and is signed off by the Department's project manager before payment. Invoices list task ID, hours spent, deliverables completed, and the resource roles billed, consistent with Section 10.0 of the SOW.

sections.heading: 3. Detail of Compensation: Rates, Hours, Tasks, and Costs
4. Not-to-Exceed Contract Ceiling
sections.body_md: All activities necessary for or incidental to this SOW are held to a not-to-exceed ceiling of {{CEILING:Not-to-exceed contract ceiling}}. Our priced tasks total {{TOTAL}}, staying under that ceiling. {{VERBATIM:scope_protection}}

sections.heading: 5. Reimbursable Expenses
sections.body_md:
{{VERBATIM:reimbursables}}

Routine travel to and from the Department's Helena office is not billed. All other approved travel and expenses are itemized on invoices, tracked monthly, and reimbursed at cost, included within the not-to-exceed ceiling.

internal_notes.issue: cost_weight_pct is null; RFP gives no scoring weight for cost, consistent with High-tier selection, but confirm no separate scoring sheet exists before final submission.

Implied limit: the $950,000 budget must be fully expended by May 31, 2029. Our plan sizes priced tasks to ~75% of the ceiling now (leaving room to add years 2-5 execution work via scope addenda) but Sonja should confirm the multi-year spend-down pace matches program milestones so funds aren't left unspent near the deadline.
Media buying/placement line assumes a $430,000 total media budget over the term (not stated in RFP) — needs Department confirmation before locking the 85/15 split.

PSA video replacement set assumes 4 videos; graphic/print asset bundle assumes 40 assets; project management assumes a 5-year cadence at ~40 hrs/year of Account Manager time. All are placeholder quantities pending kickoff scoping with DPHHS.
No buyer_form was extracted from the RFP, so no form_fills were generated; confirm the state doesn't require a separate cost form/spreadsheet submission.

all_inclusive_pricing is false, so the reimbursables verbatim is used; confirm this is acceptable to a state agency accustomed to itemized travel reimbursement only (no capital costs referenced in RFP).
Track labels 'Direct Outreach' and 'Influencer Outreach' have no stated sub-ceilings in the RFP; they are priced as scope groupings only, not separate NTEs.
